segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let romanNumeralDict: [Int: String] = [1: "I", 2: "II", 3: "III", 5: "V"] do { let stream = Counter(howHigh: 5) .map { (value) throws -> String in guard let roman = romanNumeralDict[value] else { throw MyError() } return roman } for try await numeral in stream { print(numeral, terminator: " ") } } catch { print("Error: \(error)") } // Prints "I II III Error: MyError() " ```
segments.contextBefore: Also, the dictionary doesn’t provide a key for `4`, and the closure throws an error for any key it can’t look up, so receiving this value from `Counter` ends the modified sequence with an error.
